-- Notes:
-- Removed LOWER from natco_code as there is no value in caps
-- Internalemployee filter is always 'no' in whole dataset so removing additional filter

-- (Tariff Change) - CR by steps OPT

WITH base AS (
    SELECT 
         DATE(event_date) AS dt
        ,event_date
        ,page_name
        ,session_id
        ,action
    FROM silver_layer.t_link_journey_checkout_com
    WHERE 
        {{date}}
        AND (
            'All' IN ({{servie_line}})
            OR lower(service_line) = lower({{servie_line}})
            OR lower(ui_page_category) = lower({{servie_line}})
        )
     -- AND lower(internalemployee) = 'no'
        AND natco_code = 'de'
        AND (
            'All' IN ({{os_naame}})
            OR lower(user_device_type) = lower({{os_naame}})
        )
        AND lower(category) = 'tariffchange'
        [[ AND {{natco}} ]]
        AND (
            'All' IN ({{category}})
            OR category = {{category}}
            OR LOWER(category) = {{category}}
        )
),
funnel_counts AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc(
            CASE 
                WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'daily'   THEN 'day'
                WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'weekly'  THEN 'week'
                WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'monthly' THEN 'month'
            END,
            dt
        ) AS period_sort,
        CASE 
            WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'daily' THEN
                format_datetime(dt, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
            WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'weekly' THEN
                CONCAT(
                    format_datetime(date_trunc('week', dt), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),
                    ' -Wk',
                    CAST(week_of_year(dt) AS VARCHAR)
                )
            WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'monthly' THEN
                format_datetime(date_trunc('month', dt), 'MMM-yyyy')
        END AS period,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lower(page_name) LIKE '%basket%'                                                THEN session_id END) AS basket_page,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lower(page_name) LIKE '%checkout/account%'        AND lower(action) = 'pageview' THEN session_id END) AS registration_page_optional,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lower(page_name) LIKE '%checkout/personalinfo%'   AND lower(action) = 'pageview' THEN session_id END) AS personalinfo_page,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lower(page_name) LIKE '%checkout/identification%' AND lower(action) = 'pageview' THEN session_id END) AS ident_page_optional,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lower(page_name) LIKE '%checkout/appointment%'    AND lower(action) = 'pageview' THEN session_id END) AS appointment_page_optional,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lower(page_name) LIKE '%checkout/payment%'        AND lower(action) = 'pageview' THEN session_id END) AS payment_page,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lower(page_name) LIKE '%consent%'                 AND lower(action) = 'pageview' THEN session_id END) AS orderreview_page,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lower(action) = 'purchasesuccess'                                                THEN session_id END) AS order_placed
    FROM base
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
    period,
    basket_page,
    ROUND(registration_page_optional  * 1.0 / NULLIF(basket_page, 0), 3) AS "registration_page_(optional)",
    ROUND(personalinfo_page           * 1.0 / NULLIF(basket_page, 0), 3) AS personalinfo_page,
    ROUND(ident_page_optional         * 1.0 / NULLIF(basket_page, 0), 3) AS "ident_page_(optional)",
    ROUND(appointment_page_optional   * 1.0 / NULLIF(basket_page, 0), 3) AS "appointment_page_(optional)",
    ROUND(payment_page                * 1.0 / NULLIF(basket_page, 0), 3) AS payment_page,
    ROUND(orderreview_page            * 1.0 / NULLIF(basket_page, 0), 3) AS orderreview_page,
    ROUND(order_placed                * 1.0 / NULLIF(basket_page, 0), 3) AS order_placed
FROM funnel_counts
ORDER BY period_sort;
